scientific_limitations: The Euclidean metric is canonical and not preserved by an arbitrary affine transformation of the outer simplex.
The theorem covers edge-trisection ratio 2, not every possible division ratio.
Historical priority is provisional because unindexed equivalent bounded-ratio simplex results may exist.
The exact finite checker is corroboration, not an independent formal proof.
title: The complementary matching theorem for Euclidean diameters of Marion central polytopes
